archetypes.label: Supreme Source
archetypes.blurb: The ultimate ground of being behind and above the named gods.

archetypes.label: Creator
archetypes.blurb: The power that brings the ordered world into existence.

archetypes.label: Preserver
archetypes.blurb: The power that maintains the world and restores its order.

archetypes.label: Destroyer / Transformer
archetypes.blurb: The power that dissolves the world so it can be remade.

archetypes.label: Sky Father / Thunderer
archetypes.blurb: Ruler of the sky who wields storm and lightning.

archetypes.label: Sun
archetypes.blurb: The solar deity or the sun's driver.

archetypes.label: Moon
archetypes.blurb: The lunar deity and keeper of the month.

archetypes.label: Dawn
archetypes.blurb: The deity of first light.

archetypes.label: Fire
archetypes.blurb: Fire as god, and as the channel between mortals and gods.

archetypes.label: Wind & Storm
archetypes.blurb: The moving air, breath and tempest.

archetypes.label: Sea & Waters
archetypes.blurb: Ocean, river and the cosmic waters.

archetypes.label: Earth & Mother Goddess
archetypes.blurb: The earth, and the mother of divine lineages.

archetypes.label: Death & Judgment
archetypes.blurb: The lord of the dead who judges what a life earned.

archetypes.label: War & Battle
archetypes.blurb: The deity who leads and decides battle.

archetypes.label: Wisdom, Craft & Learning
archetypes.blurb: Knowledge, speech, artifice and the making of things.

archetypes.label: Love & Desire
archetypes.blurb: Attraction, passion and the force that couples the world.

archetypes.label: Wealth & Fortune
archetypes.blurb: Prosperity, treasure and good luck.

archetypes.label: Healing & Medicine
archetypes.blurb: The restorer of health, and the origin of medicine.

archetypes.label: Messenger & Trickster
archetypes.blurb: The go-between who carries word and stirs events.

archetypes.label: Serpent & Dragon
archetypes.blurb: The great serpent: cosmic support, or cosmic obstruction.

archetypes.label: Primordial Adversary
archetypes.blurb: The power that opposes the gods and the order they keep.

archetypes.label: Divine Beast & Mount
archetypes.blurb: The animal that carries or serves a god.

archetypes.label: Mortal Hero & Champion
archetypes.blurb: The mortal (or part-divine) figure whose deeds carry the epic.

archetypes.label: Sage & Seer
archetypes.blurb: The visionary who receives, transmits or authors sacred knowledge.

archetypes.label: Sacred King & Ruler
archetypes.blurb: Kingship as a sacred office within the mythic order.

archetypes.label: Fate & Time
archetypes.blurb: Time, destiny and the reckoning of deeds.
